verdict.rationale: Bugbot connects through the Cursor GitHub app, including GitHub Enterprise Server, and through the GitLab integration, including self-hosted GitLab. It runs automatically on every PR update and leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes. Community users confirm it is live in their orgs and posting PR comments. Missing for 10: any documented or measured review latency backing the "within minutes" claim.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: The Cursor GitHub app connects your repositories so you can use features like [Cloud Agents](/docs/cloud-agent) and [Bugbot](/docs/bugbot).
